name: Insight Timer
one_liner: Large free library of guided meditations, sleep tracks and talks from many teachers, with a timer; optional paid MemberPlus.
best_for: People who want a large free meditation and sleep library without paying
People who like choosing between many teachers and styles
Experienced meditators who want a flexible timer and practice stats
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need treatment for anxiety, depression or insomnia: it is a wellness app, not care
People who want one consistent, curated program rather than a big mixed library
short_description: A meditation app with a big free library from thousands of teachers, a timer, and an optional paid MemberPlus subscription.
long_description: Insight Timer offers a large free library of guided meditations, music, sleep tracks and talks from many independent teachers, along with a customizable meditation timer, progress stats, groups and live sessions. Content ranges across mindfulness, sleep, stress and anxiety, but quality and style vary from teacher to teacher. MemberPlus ($59.99/year or $9.99/month in the US, with a 7-day free trial) adds courses, offline listening and other features; some courses can also be bought one at a time. Research on the app itself is limited: a small 2023 randomized trial (100 US adults) found 10 minutes a day for 30 days reduced anxiety and improved well-being compared with no app, and a large study of app users linked consistent practice (4 to 7 days a week) with better mood and resilience.
patient_summary: Insight Timer gives you thousands of free guided meditations, sleep tracks and talks, plus a simple timer for silent practice. Most content is free; MemberPlus costs $59.99 a year or $9.99 a month if you want courses and offline listening. Teachers and quality vary, so try a few to find what suits you.

pricing.notes: Most of the library is free. MemberPlus adds courses, offline listening and more, with a 7-day free trial; prices vary by country and store. Some courses can be bought individually.

privacy.notes: Insight Timer's help center (March 2026) says it does not sell or share app or website data for advertising; deletion on request via the app or privacy@insighttimer.com. The policy still lists analytics and advertising partners and doesn't honor Do Not Track, and Mozilla (2023) reported ad-network use, so review cookie settings.

seo.title: Insight Timer: Free Meditation Library | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Insight Timer is a free meditation app with over 150,000 guided meditations, music tracks, and courses from thousands of teachers worldwide.

faqs.a: Yes, Insight Timer's core offering is free—over 150,000 meditations, music tracks, and courses. Premium membership (~$60/year) adds offline listening, advanced features, and courses, but most users find the free version sufficient.

faqs.q: How is Insight Timer different from Calm or Headspace?
faqs.a: Insight Timer offers vastly more free content from thousands of teachers, while Calm and Headspace have smaller, more curated libraries behind paywalls. Insight Timer has more variety but less polish. Try all three to find your preference.

faqs.q: What content does Insight Timer offer?
faqs.a: Guided meditations across all styles, sleep music, ambient sounds, meditation courses, talks on mindfulness and personal growth, and live community events. Content ranges from 1 minute to multi-hour.

faqs.q: Is Insight Timer good for beginners?
faqs.a: Yes, Insight Timer has extensive beginner content. However, the sheer volume can be overwhelming. Use collections, teacher filtering, or their beginner courses to navigate. Many prefer simpler apps initially.

clinical_trials.study: 10 minutes a day of Insight Timer for 30 days vs no app, US adults during COVID-19

citation.title: Effectiveness of Daily Mindfulness Meditation App Usage to Reduce Anxiety and Improve Well-Being During the COVID-19 Pandemic: A Randomized Controlled Trial

clinical_trials.outcome: Lower anxiety (GAD-7) and better well-being (WHO-5) than controls; small, open-label trial.
clinical_trials.study_design: Randomized controlled trial (no-app control, open label)

clinical_trials.study: Real-world Insight Timer users in 103 countries rating mood before and after sessions over 14 months

citation.title: The Effects of Dose, Practice Habits, and Objects of Focus on Digital Meditation Effectiveness and Adherence: Longitudinal Study of 280,000 Digital Meditation Sessions Across 103 Countries

clinical_trials.outcome: Mood, equanimity and resilience improved; practising 4 to 7 days a week was linked to the largest change.

primary_uses: Guided meditation for stress and anxiety
